source: production detections.damage_type, all 2,979 rows as of 2026-09-09, read-only query via the platform backend
normalization: NFKC, trim, collapse whitespace, lowercase, dash fold (same rule the engine applies at the detection boundary)
hash_method: sha256 of json.dumps(sorted(vocabulary), sort_keys=True), first 16 hex characters (identical to tools/class_vocabulary_audit.py in the Phase 1 tool; that method reproduces the Aug 6 fixture hash 1471ba6fe5b839bb exactly)

supersedes.basis: 36-record fixture, 6 classes (biological growth, corrosion, cracking, decay, erosion, spalling). Never signed off. erosion has zero production rows; loss, coating failure and rust staining were absent from the fixture.
